tip_registration_chain.method: Read source registrations and current generated rows/registration loops; no live registry initialization.

condition_preconditions: Normal left click; valid permitted recipe, sufficient ordinary ingredients, one output item per craft and stack capacity 64.
The optional tip is a registered infinite robot tip, already a valid actual grid ingredient; no claim about every crafting recipe.
Source empty cursor is null; current empty cursor is ItemStack.EMPTY. No input or output capacity failure other than the stated cursor condition.
example_limit: Eight source-guard conditions, not executed Java, actual native menu clicks, recipes or inventory mutation tests.
preserved_boundaries: Both direct GT charging loops offer one packet to each of five tool slots; modern demand simulation uses a copy.
Source root and current FE entry both dispatch RF with size 1 and amount equal to the offered RF quantity; do not infer an RF-to-EU conversion bug from that signature.
Direct five-slot fluid filling is separate from missing adjacent crafting refill ALIGN-296 and does not imply the table needs a new storage tank.
Keep transaction/remainder and broken-tool protections; do not change infinite-tip policy merely as a readability edit.
Source optional IC2 item compatibility is not direct proof of a missing currently applicable loader/mod API; modern external adapters need a separate decision.
limits: Source review and full code/literal/comment/directive preservation only; no new compile, Gradle, tests, game, build or push.
Direct-fluid volume/probe semantics, external energy items/APIs, all click modes, native client pixels/reload lifecycle, multiplayer and independent saved-world restart remain unverified.

root_revalidation.method: Rehash actual old/current sources and platform views, compare git baseline snapshots and complete code/literals/comments/directives, recheck direct-fluid access, ten-tip registrations, native result consumers and RF dispatch. No target execution or gameplay tests.
